title: Three or four years at the Deluxe with Garland's New Orleans Jazz Band
summary: He stays at the Deluxe until Billy Bottoms lures him to Dreamland, and recalls stealing a touring act's player for the Deluxe. The band was Garland's New Orleans Jazz Band.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Oh, I stayed, I stayed, I stayed in the Deluxe three, four years or more. Then, two years and something. Because Billy Bottoms got me to come over to Dreamland, see. Just before I went to the Dreamland, uh, Basie come to Chicago with, uh, P.R. this woman who called, oh, it was already a TV time, uh, show, what's that called? Come there with a show and a heart, and I went and got Basie. I stole Basie and bought Basie up to the Deluxe side to do it.
What did they call that band? The band at Deluxe. What, what, what was the name of the band at the Deluxe?
Oh, Garland's New Orleans Jazz Band.
Oh yeah? Garland's New Orleans Jazz Band. Uh-huh. Jazz band, yeah.
